correctness.rationale: PASS: For a full-support sign array a on n-by-n square, |P_a(z,w)|² on the complete torus is a finite Laurent polynomial with coefficients the aperiodic autocorrelations C_a(r,s); equality of intensities is equivalent to coefficient equality. Global sign fixes upper-left entry +1; simultaneous central reversal produces the other trivial equivalence, with no other signs/translations permitted. Independently enumerated all 2^(n²-1) normalized codes at each n=1,2,3,4, computed all nonredundant shifts as exact integer inner products, grouped complete correlation fibers modulo reversal, and tested each rank-one/tensor status. Fiber size histograms are n1 (1 single), n2 (6 singles), n3 (134 singles,1 double), n4 (16488 singles,12 doubles); exactly eight of the 12 n4 doubles are entirely nonseparable; n3 none. The explicit codes 12442 and 3238 are an inequivalent nonseparable equal-correlation witness. This is a complete finite exhaustive certificate for n<=4, not an inference about larger squares.
